newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen B shares end up despite A share losses.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares end up despite A share losses.

text.p: Shenzhen's hard currency B share market rallied in sluggish trade on Wednesday, despite a drop in the A share index driven down just before closing by market leader Shenzhen Development Bank brokers said.
The B share index rose 1.24 points or 0.94 percent to 133.33 points on thin turnover of HK$44 million against Tuesday's HK$36 million.
The domestic A share index shed 1.19 points or 0.28 percent to 421.21 points, with turnover expanding to 7.7 billion yuan from 5.4 billion on Tuesday.
